title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Training Note: Counting the Alignment Checks a Charge Bills
content:
How many checks the alignment check charge on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order bills follows the order's check record:

- **Correction recorded.** Where a correction is recorded on the order, the checks billed are the checks recorded less one for each correction, because the re-check that follows a correction is part of the correction.
- **No correction, lapsed first check.** Where no correction is recorded, two or more checks are recorded and the order's latest check was made more than the tier's alignment check validity days after its first check, only the latest check is billed, because the earlier check lapsed unused. The tier's alignment check validity is 30 calendar days on every tier.
- **Any other order.** On any other order every check recorded is billed.

Days are calendar days counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date not counted.

## Terms, in the words of the order's records

- A **correction is recorded** where an alignment check on the order shows that the out-of-spec alignment was corrected in the same visit; each such check is one correction.
- The **first check** is the order's check number 1; the **latest check** is the order's most recent check by date.

## Questions and answers

**An order has three checks recorded and one of them shows the alignment corrected in the same visit. How many checks are billed?** Three less one: two.

**An order has two checks, no correction, the first on 1 March and the latest on 31 March. How many are billed?** From 1 March to 31 March is 30 days, which is not more than 30, so every check recorded is billed: two.

**The same order, but the latest check is on 1 April?** From 1 March to 1 April is 31 days, more than 30, so only the latest check is billed: one.

**An order has a single check and no correction?** It is not an order with two or more checks; every check recorded is billed: one.

## Summary table (hypothetical orders)

| Checks recorded | Corrections recorded | Days from first to latest check | Checks billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | any | 2 |
| 4 | 2 | any | 2 |
| 2 | 0 | 45 | 1 |
| 2 | 0 | 30 | 2 |
| 3 | 0 | 31 | 1 |
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
